'''The Key to Triple Battles''' (Japanese: '''トリプルバトルの極意！！''' ''Triple Battle Essentials!!'') is the second chapter of the [[Be the Best! Pokémon B+W]] manga. It was published in the October 2010 issue of [[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Comics Special]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* It is revealed that [[Monta]] has a {{p|Roggenrola}} and a {{p|Panpour}}.
* [[Cheren]]'s {{p|Tepig}} is revealed to know {{m|Ember}}.
* Cheren is revealed to have a {{p|Pansage}} and {{p|Basculin}}.
